component_offers.name: Titanium(IV) isopropoxide, 99.995% (metals basis)
component_offers.notes: Public US catalog pack quote, not explicit MSRP. Account/contract pricing may differ. Excludes shipping, taxes, hazmat and handling. Exact chemical identity as a reference market offer. Grade, stabilizer, concentration, supplier and purity must be reviewed against source formulation; no automatic recipe eligibility, dosage, yield or output claim. The existing source component names 99.9% titanium isopropoxide; this offered grade is 99.995% (metals basis), a higher-purity market alternative. It is below the distinct 99.999% source identity and must not be assigned to that identity. Existing generic titanium-isopropoxide offers mean this does not close a wholly new chemical-identity price gap.
